title: The Ewenki
synopsis: The Ewenki are the only ethnic group in China that raises reindeer. This article explores their unique culture and adaptation to modern society.

fullText.simplified:
鄂温克族

    鄂温克族是中国传统少数民族。“鄂温克”的意思是“住在大山林中的人们”。目前中国的鄂温克族不足4万人，主要居住在中国内蒙古和黑龙江两省。
    日常生活中，鄂温克人使用鄂温克语，但是没有本族的文字。随着时代的发展，在现代社会生活中，鄂温克人普遍掌握了汉语、蒙语，有很多汉语和蒙语的词汇进入了鄂温克语中。
    鄂温克族主要的食物是奶制品、肉和面食。奶茶是他们喜欢的饮料。
最早的鄂温克族住在山林中，随着社会和经济的发展，鄂温克族下山定居，有的继续从事畜牧业，有的从事农业，有的通过驯鹿文化、桦树皮文化（鄂温克族的日常生活中，很多物品是桦树皮制作的）等大力发展旅游业。
    鄂温克族喜欢唱歌。他们的民歌特点是即景生情，即兴填词。他们常用同样的曲调，在不同场合填上不同的词，来表达心中的喜怒哀乐，歌曲富有草原和森林的气息。
    鄂温克族还是中国唯一个驯养驯鹿的民族。鄂温克人无论男女老少都非常喜爱和保护驯鹿，将它们视为吉祥、幸福的象征，也是追求美好和理想的象征。因此鄂温克人将驯鹿定为了鄂温克族的吉祥物。
    在中国，鄂温克族是一个有着光荣斗争传统的民族，在维护国家统一、保卫祖国边疆的斗争中，做出了重要贡献。关于鄂温克族，还有很多神秘有趣的文化呢！有机会的话，你可以来中国亲自感受一下鄂温克人的热情。
fullText.traditional:
鄂溫克族

    鄂溫克族是中國傳統少數民族。“鄂溫克”的意思是“住在大山林中的人們”。目前中國的鄂溫克族不足4萬人，主要居住在中國內蒙古和黑龍江兩省。
    日常生活中，鄂溫克人使用鄂溫克語，但是沒有本族的文字。隨著時代的發展，在現代社會生活中，鄂溫克人普遍掌握了漢語、濛語，有很多漢語和濛語的詞彙進入了鄂溫克語中。
    鄂溫克族主要的食物是奶製品、肉和麵食。奶茶是他們喜歡的飲料。
最早的鄂溫克族住在山林中，隨著社會和經濟的發展，鄂溫克族下山定居，有的繼續從事畜牧業，有的從事農業，有的通過馴鹿文化、樺樹皮文化（鄂溫克族的日常生活中，很多物品是樺樹皮製作的）等大力發展旅遊業。
    鄂溫克族喜歡唱歌。他們的民歌特點是即景生情，即興填詞。他們常用同樣的曲調，在不同場合填上不同的詞，來表達心中的喜怒哀樂，歌曲富有草原和森林的氣息。
    鄂溫克族還是中國唯一個馴養馴鹿的民族。鄂溫克人無論男女老少都非常喜愛和保護馴鹿，將牠們視為吉祥、幸福的象徵，也是追求美好和理想的象徵。因此鄂溫克人將馴鹿定為了鄂溫克族的吉祥物。
    在中國，鄂溫克族是一個有著光榮鬥爭傳統的民族，在維護國家統一、保衛祖國邊疆的鬥爭中，做出了重要貢獻。關於鄂溫克族，還有很多神秘有趣的文化呢！有機會的話，你可以來中國親自感受一下鄂溫克人的熱情。

Many Chinese and Mongolian words have entered the Evenki language.

sentences.simplified: 大力发展旅游业。
sentences.traditional: 大力發展旅遊業。
sentences.pinyin: dà lì fā zhǎn lǚ yóu yè

.. to vigorously develop tourism.

The songs are rich with the atmosphere of the grasslands and forests.

sentences.traditional: 將牠們視為吉祥、幸福的象徵，也是追求美好和理想的象徵。
sentences.pinyin: jiāng tā men shì wéi jí xiáng xìng fú de xiàng zhēng yě shì zhuī qiú měi hǎo hé lǐ xiǎng de xiàng zhēng

sentences.english: .. seeing them as symbols of good fortune and happiness, as well as symbols of the pursuit of beauty and ideals.
Therefore, the Ewenki have designated the reindeer as the mascot of the Ewenki ethnic group.

sentences.traditional: 在維護國家統一、保衛祖國邊疆的鬥爭中，做出了重要貢獻。

sentences.english: In China, the Ewenki are an ethnic group with a glorious tradition of struggle.

sentences.simplified: 关于鄂温克族，还有很多神秘有趣的文化呢！

sentences.english: They have made significant contributions in the struggle to maintain national unity and defend the borders of the motherland.

sentences.simplified: 有机会的话，你可以来中国亲自感受一下鄂温克人的热情。

sentences.english: There are many mysterious and interesting aspects about the Ewenki culture!

sentence_translations: The Ewenki
The Ewenki are a traditional ethnic minority in China.
The meaning of “Ewenki” is “people who live in the mountains and forests”.
The Evenki population in China is currently less than 40,000, mainly living in the two provinces of Inner Mongolia and Heilongjiang.
In daily life, the Ewenki people use the Ewenki language, but they do not have their own written language.
With the development of the times, in modern society, the Ewenki people have generally mastered Chinese and Mongolian.
Many Chinese and Mongolian words have entered the Evenki language.
The main foods of the Ewenki people are dairy products, meat, and wheat. Milk tea is their favorite drink.
The earliest Ewenki people lived in the mountains and forests.
With the development of society and economy, the Ewenki have come down from the mountains to settle.
Some continue to engage in animal husbandry, and some are engaged in agriculture.
Some have used reindeer culture, birch bark culture (in the daily life of the Ewenki, many items are made of birch bark), and so on ..
.. to vigorously develop tourism.
The Ewenki love to sing.
The characteristic of their folk songs is that they are inspired by the scenery and the lyrics are improvised.
They often use the same melody, filling in different lyrics for different occasions, to express all their emotions.
The songs are rich with the atmosphere of the grasslands and forests.
The Ewenki people are also the only ethnic group in China that domesticate reindeer.
All of the Ewenki people are very fond of and protective of reindeer, ..
.. seeing them as symbols of good fortune and happiness, as well as symbols of the pursuit of beauty and ideals.
Therefore, the Ewenki have designated the reindeer as the mascot of the Ewenki ethnic group.
In China, the Ewenki are an ethnic group with a glorious tradition of struggle.
They have made significant contributions in the struggle to maintain national unity and defend the borders of the motherland.
There are many mysterious and interesting aspects about the Ewenki culture!
If you have the opportunity, you can come to China to personally experience the warmth of the Ewenki people for yourself.
